project.idea_text: I want an online food delivery app

summary: An online food delivery application that allows users to browse local restaurants, place food orders, make payments, and track deliveries in real-time, while providing restaurants and couriers with management tools.
assumptions: The platform will initially launch as a web application and mobile apps for iOS and Android.
Payment processing will be handled by a third-party gateway like Stripe.
User authentication will support email/password and standard social logins.
Geospatial mapping and routing will rely on a third-party service such as Google Maps.

requirements.text: Users can create a new account using an email address and password.
Users can search for restaurants by cuisine type, name, or location.
Users can add menu items from a restaurant to their shopping cart.
Users can securely pay for their food order using a credit card.
Restaurants can accept or reject incoming orders through a dashboard.
Users receive automated notifications regarding the status of their delivery.
95% of search requests return results in under 500 ms.
All user passwords must be securely hashed using bcrypt before storage.
The mobile interface complies with WCAG 2.1 AA accessibility standards.

epics.title: User Accounts and Authentication
epics.description: Manages user registration and secure credential storage.

epics.title: Restaurant Discovery and Ordering
epics.description: Enables users to search for food, manage their cart, and place orders.

epics.title: Payments and Fulfillment
epics.description: Handles secure checkout, payment processing, and restaurant order management.

epics.title: Platform and Quality
epics.description: Covers notifications, performance benchmarks, and accessibility standards.

stories.i_want: to create a new account using an email address and password
stories.so_that: I can access the food delivery platform
acceptance_criteria: Given valid email and password, when I submit registration, then my account is created.
Given an existing email, when I register, then an error is shown.

stories.i_want: all user passwords to be securely hashed using bcrypt before storage
stories.so_that: user credentials remain secure even in the event of a data breach
acceptance_criteria: Given a user password, when it is stored in the database, then it is hashed using bcrypt.
Given a login attempt, when verifying credentials, then the hash is checked correctly.

stories.i_want: to search for restaurants by cuisine type, name, or location
stories.so_that: I can find food options that match my preferences
acceptance_criteria: Given search keywords, when I search, then matching restaurants are displayed.
Given no matching results, when I search, then a polite empty state is shown.

stories.i_want: to add menu items from a restaurant to their shopping cart
stories.so_that: I can prepare my order before checkout
acceptance_criteria: Given a restaurant menu, when I select an item, then it is added to my cart.
Given items from multiple restaurants, when I add them, then a warning is shown.

stories.i_want: to securely pay for their food order using a credit card
acceptance_criteria: Given a cart and payment details, when I pay, then the transaction is processed securely.
Given invalid card details, when I pay, then an error message is displayed.

stories.i_want: to accept or reject incoming orders through a dashboard
stories.so_that: we can manage kitchen workflow and prepare food on time
acceptance_criteria: Given a new order, when I view the dashboard, then I can click accept or reject.
Given an accepted order, when the status changes, then the customer is updated.

stories.i_want: to receive automated notifications regarding the status of their delivery
stories.so_that: I know when to expect my food
acceptance_criteria: Given an order status change, when it occurs, then a notification is sent to the user.
Given a delivery update, when received, then it displays clearly on the device.

stories.i_want: 95% of search requests to return results in under 500 ms
stories.so_that: users experience a fast and responsive interface
acceptance_criteria: Given search traffic, when measured over time, then 95% of requests complete under 500ms.
Given slow queries, when analyzed, then they are optimized.

stories.i_want: the mobile interface to comply with WCAG 2.1 AA accessibility standards
stories.so_that: users with disabilities can successfully navigate the app
acceptance_criteria: Given the mobile app, when audited against WCAG 2.1 AA, then no critical violations are found.
Given screen reader usage, when navigating, then elements are properly announced.

tasks.title: Create users table and migration
tasks.description: Create the database schema for storing user accounts including email and password fields.
tasks.estimate_rationale: Simple database migration to set up the users table.

tasks.title: Implement register-user endpoint
tasks.description: Implement backend endpoint to handle new user registration with email and password, returning validation errors for existing emails.
tasks.estimate_rationale: Standard backend endpoint implementation with validation and creation logic.

tasks.title: Build registration form frontend
tasks.description: Create the sign-up UI allowing users to enter email and password and handle success and error states.
tasks.estimate_rationale: Frontend registration form with inputs and basic validation logic.

tasks.title: Write tests for user registration
tasks.description: Add unit and integration tests covering successful registration and duplicate email error handling.
tasks.estimate_rationale: Unit and integration tests covering the registration flow.

tasks.title: Implement bcrypt password hashing
tasks.description: Integrate bcrypt service in the authentication flow to hash passwords before storing and verify them during login.
tasks.estimate_rationale: Integration of bcrypt hashing into the user creation pipeline.

tasks.title: Write tests for password security
tasks.description: Verify that plain text passwords are never stored and authentication checks hashes correctly.
tasks.estimate_rationale: Specific security tests for password hashing correctness.

tasks.title: Create restaurants and menus tables
tasks.description: Create database schema and migrations for restaurants, cuisine types, and menu items to support search and discovery.
tasks.estimate_rationale: Multiple database tables with relationships for restaurants and menus.

tasks.title: Implement search-restaurants endpoint
tasks.description: Build backend API to filter and search restaurants by name, cuisine type, and location keywords.
tasks.estimate_rationale: Backend search endpoint supporting multiple query parameters and filters.

tasks.title: Build restaurant search interface
tasks.description: Develop frontend search bar and results view including handling for polite empty states when no results match.
tasks.estimate_rationale: Frontend search interface with filters and results display.

tasks.title: Write tests for restaurant search
tasks.description: Add unit and integration tests covering keyword search, filters, and empty state handling.
tasks.estimate_rationale: Tests covering various search filter combinations and edge cases.

tasks.title: Create shopping cart data model
tasks.description: Create database schema and session storage rules for cart items tied to specific restaurants.
tasks.estimate_rationale: Database schema for shopping carts and items.

tasks.title: Implement manage-cart endpoints
tasks.description: Build backend endpoints to add items to cart and validate single-restaurant cart constraints.
tasks.estimate_rationale: Endpoints to manage cart state, add items, and handle restaurant validation.

tasks.title: Build shopping cart UI and warning modal
tasks.description: Develop frontend cart component allowing users to add items and displaying a warning when adding items from multiple restaurants.
tasks.estimate_rationale: Complex frontend component with cart state and a modal for multi-restaurant warnings.

tasks.title: Write tests for cart management
tasks.description: Add unit and integration tests for adding items and multi-restaurant cart validation warnings.
tasks.estimate_rationale: Tests verifying cart operations and multi-restaurant warnings.

tasks.title: Create payments table and schema
tasks.description: Create the database schema and migration for storing payment transactions linked to orders.
tasks.estimate_rationale: Database schema setup for tracking payment records.

tasks.title: Implement process-payment endpoint
tasks.description: Implement the backend endpoint to handle secure credit card transactions via the payment gateway.
tasks.estimate_rationale: Backend endpoint to process transactions securely.

tasks.title: Integrate third-party payment gateway
tasks.description: Integrate the secure payment processor SDK and handle success and error responses.
tasks.estimate_rationale: Complex third-party SDK integration with webhook handling and error management.

tasks.title: Build credit card checkout UI and error handling
tasks.description: Build the frontend checkout form with validation and display error messages for invalid card details.
tasks.estimate_rationale: Checkout UI incorporating secure card inputs and comprehensive error handling.

tasks.title: Implement update-order-status endpoint
tasks.description: Implement backend endpoint for restaurant owners to accept or reject orders and update their status.
tasks.estimate_rationale: Backend endpoint to update order status with authorization checks.

tasks.title: Build restaurant dashboard order management UI
tasks.description: Create the dashboard interface for restaurant owners to view incoming orders and click accept or reject.
tasks.estimate_rationale: Dashboard screen allowing restaurant staff to manage incoming orders.

tasks.title: Test order acceptance and status updates
tasks.description: Write automated tests verifying that order status changes correctly notify the customer.
tasks.estimate_rationale: Tests for order status transitions and acceptance flows.

tasks.title: Implement notification service integration
tasks.description: Build backend integration with a push notification service to send order status changes to users.
tasks.estimate_rationale: Integration with external notification service providers.

tasks.title: Implement delivery status display on frontend
tasks.description: Build frontend components to clearly display real-time delivery updates on the user device.
tasks.estimate_rationale: Frontend component displaying real-time delivery status updates.

tasks.title: Test notification and status update flow
tasks.description: Write automated tests for the notification trigger and frontend status display behavior.
tasks.estimate_rationale: Tests verifying notification triggers and status updates.

tasks.title: Optimize search query performance
tasks.description: Analyze slow database queries and add appropriate indexes to ensure search completes under 500ms.
tasks.estimate_rationale: Database optimization involving query tuning and appropriate indexing.

tasks.title: Implement search latency monitoring
tasks.description: Set up performance metrics and monitoring to track search request response times over time.
tasks.estimate_rationale: Setting up monitoring tools and metrics for latency tracking.

tasks.title: Test search performance under load
tasks.description: Run load tests to verify that 95% of search requests return results in under 500ms.
tasks.estimate_rationale: Load testing scripts and execution to validate search performance.

tasks.title: Design WCAG 2.1 AA compliant UI components
tasks.description: Review and update mobile interface designs to meet contrast, typography, and accessibility standards.
tasks.estimate_rationale: Design specifications and component definitions for accessibility standards.

tasks.title: Implement accessible mobile interface elements
tasks.description: Update frontend components with proper ARIA labels and screen reader support for WCAG 2.1 AA compliance.
tasks.estimate_rationale: Implementing accessibility features across multiple frontend elements.

tasks.title: Audit mobile app accessibility
tasks.description: Perform automated and manual accessibility audits to ensure no critical WCAG 2.1 AA violations exist.
tasks.estimate_rationale: Running accessibility audits and documenting compliance results.

signals.message: CPM duration is 72 h (12 working days); 4 of 30 tasks (13%) are critical.
T-015 "Create payments table and schema" has 6 downstream tasks and 0 h slack (CPM).
2 of 3 sprints are packed to at least 98% of capacity, so there is no buffer for estimation error.
Capacity-feasible plan is 30 working days (3 sprints) against a CPM minimum of 12 working days: ratio 2.50x.

risks.title: Critical Payments Task With High Fanout and Zero Slack
risks.description: According to the critical-path schedule fact in signal SG-02, task T-015 "Create payments table and schema" has 6 downstream tasks and 0 h slack, meaning any delay here directly extends the project timeline. Signal SG-01 notes that the CPM duration is 72 h (12 working days) with 4 of 30 tasks (13%) being critical.
risks.mitigation: Prioritize immediate resource allocation and rigorous quality checks on T-015 and its dependent critical path tasks to prevent cascading schedule delays.

risks.title: Sprint Overload and Lack of Buffer
risks.description: Signal SG-03 indicates a capacity-plan fact that 2 of 3 sprints are packed to at least 98% of capacity, leaving no buffer for estimation errors. Furthermore, signal SG-04 notes that the capacity-feasible plan is 30 working days (3 sprints) against a CPM minimum of 12 working days, resulting in a ratio of 2.50x.
risks.mitigation: De-scope non-essential tasks from the overloaded sprints or redistribute workload to create a safety margin for unexpected delays.
